items.title: How to include custom fields in a Stripe invoice generated by a Checkout Session with custom fields?
items.body:
I'm using Stripe's hosted checkout with custom fields and it works. However, by the time the customer completes checkout by paying, the invoice is already generated and finalized (so can't be edited), and it's too late to get the custom fields out of the checkout_session.completed webhook and add them to the invoice. Is there a way to have custom fields from the checkout session appear on the invoice?

I'm not using an ecommerce platform like woocommerce. And obviously, I would prefer not to have to implement the checkout plumbing myself just to get a textfield onto the invoice (prevent payment occurring somehow during checkout, raising and modifying the invoice manually, charging the payment method, etc).

items.title: How can you pre-auth a subscription payment with stripe (after the first payment)
items.body:
I know I can pre-auth a stripe subscription with a trial period. I want to pre-auth the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, nth subscription payment. The info we are sending out is time critical and if their subscription lapses due to NSF or something else, it would be nice for them if they could rectify the problem BEFORE it lapses.

There is a pending invoice you can get for a subscription, and you can create a payment intent with an invoice ID so that when the invoice is paid, the payment intent (that captured the money) will be used to collect the money. BUT the pending invoice doesn't have an ID until one or 2 hours before they try to collect the money which is 3-4 days too late.

Has anyone figured out how to pre-auth subscription payments other than the first one?

Is there a subscription engine I could use (with stripe/paypal/venmo) that would mean I could quit using the deficient stripe subscription system?
